name: us-income
title: US income per tax return (AGI, USD)
description: Adjusted gross income per federal tax return, tax year 2023. Includes wages, investment, business and capital-gains income; joint filers count as one return (so this is closer to household than individual income). Median and up: IRS Table 4.1 percentile floors (to the top 0.001%). Below the median: IRS Table 1.1 AGI brackets, adjusted to exclude dependents' returns. See scripts/build_us_income.py.
